warnings: A vs B conflict (6K+EIS): Spec page footnote '6K *Cannot be used in conjunction with EIS' vs manual p.100 '6K cannot be used … Electronic Stabilization'. Both forbidding is consistent wording, but note A frames it as 'may not be used together' narrow to 6K, while manual also lists H.264 and DC Crop alongside EIS for 6K. Treat EIS as unavailable at 6K; retain condition string.

A vs B conflict (burst): Spec page lists 'Number of Recordable Frames JPEG 1000, DNG 350' and 'Selectable 3/5/8 fps'; manual p.58 caution says 'Approximately 100 or more frames … may fall below 100 depending on settings'. The 1000/350 numbering vs '100+' are different measures (JPEG total vs in-buffer continuity) and both must be preserved rather than reconciled.

A vs B conflict (EIS scope): Spec page p.92 text mixes EIS-only-in-video with LENS OPTICAL STABILIZATION and tripod advice; manual p.92-93 adds 'EIS cannot be simultaneously used with Lens Optical Stabilization' and x1.25 crop (x1.96 DC). ibis field therefore remains present:false for body while lens OIS is a separate feature; do not collapse them.
Weight basis: Spec page gives 446 g 'including battery' as the primary number and 388 g body only. Contract requires weight with basis; capture both, do not silently drop one.
Shutter: no mechanical shutter (manual p.19 explicit). Fastest 1/25600 and slowest timed 30 s with Bulb up to 5 min come only from spec page A; not repeated in manual excerpts reviewed.
video.bitDepth: A only lists codecs (H.264/H.265/L-Log) and 'RAW(DNG)14-bit' for stills; do not transfer 14-bit to video. Bit-depth for movies is unsupported → null.
video.cropAtMax: no 6K crop factor stated; only EIS crop x1.25 (x1.96 DC) and 'DC Crop Mode' exclusion for 6K. Leave null.
LCD: only '3.15 type, Approx. 2.1M dots, electrostatic capacitance touch, TFT color LCD, 3:2'. Mechanism (fixed/tilt/etc.) is not stated → null. Do not assume fixed.

EVF: no electronic viewfinder is listed anywhere in these sources. Contract asks for resolution/magnification/maxRefreshHz; the correct outcome is 'absent in sources' not 'no EVF exists on real device'. Use null/evf.present null rather than false to avoid asserting a negative.

cardSlots: sources describe internal 230 GB + USB storage backup, not a card slot. Contract explicitly excludes internal/backup from cardSlots. If cardSlots must be non-null per schema, use null, not count 0. No SD/SSD slot is documented in A/B/C excerpts provided.
sensor.generation: no back-illuminated vs stacked wording beyond 'Back-illuminated CMOS'. Do not claim BSI Gen2/Stacked; supply the literal string only.
dimensions/weight are single-source (A only); no cross-check in B/C excerpts.
source C duplicates paragraph and is marketing; treat numbers (14,000 JPEG, 4,300 RAW, 2.5h) as supplementary, not replacements, for A's 1000/350 (still different units).
attempts.summary: Sigma BF public sources (official global spec page A, official EN manual B, Korean regional page C) reviewed against the proposed minimal contract. Several required fields are unsatisfiable from these sources (sensor.generation, EVF resolution/magnification/refresh, LCD mechanism); others are only partially supported (weight basis, bulb duration, burst). One internal policy conflict on burst frames and one A-vs-B usability conflict on EIS coexist. Detailed field-by-field findings, conditions, and unsupported guesses below.
